# LX-N Music Aurora 1.8.85-aurora.1

## 中文

这是基于 LX-N Music 1.8.85 的非官方维护版，源码基线为
`souvenp/lx-netease-music-mobile` 提交 `ab08729`。

### 主要修复

- 改善 QQ 音源搜索偶发加载失败的问题。
- QQ 音源播放优先在 QQ 同源内部按音质降级尝试，减少错误切到其它来源。
- QQ 音源下载增加同源音质重试和 0B 空文件保护。
- 避免 QQ URL 缓存复用过期链接或被其它来源结果污染。

### 安装与校验

- 安装后应用显示名为 `LX-N Music Aurora`，版本名为 `1.8.85-aurora.1`。
- Android 包名仍为 `com.lxnetease.music.mobile`，便于沿用原数据目录和系统关联。
- 如无法覆盖安装，请先备份数据并卸载旧版。

- SHA-256：`2F0D17C5BD137C0C2E9BEC8A148C77AC76208BF69D0B0F3D5FBF665BF816A125`
- versionCode：`70004`
- APK 签名：v1 / v2 / v3 校验通过
- 当前环境未连接手机或模拟器，未做自动化实机回归测试。

## English

This is an unofficial maintenance build based on LX-N Music 1.8.85, using
`souvenp/lx-netease-music-mobile` commit `ab08729` as the source baseline.

### Fixes

- Improves intermittent QQ source search loading failures.
- Keeps QQ playback on the QQ source first and falls back through QQ qualities
  before cross-source fallback is considered.
- Adds same-source QQ quality retry and 0-byte file protection for downloads.
- Avoids stale QQ URL reuse and cross-source cache pollution.

### Install And Verification

- After installation, Android should show the app as `LX-N Music Aurora` with
  version name `1.8.85-aurora.1`.
- Android package id remains `com.lxnetease.music.mobile`, so the original app
  data directory and system associations can still be used.
- If Android refuses to upgrade in place, back up app data and uninstall the
  existing build first.

- SHA-256: `2F0D17C5BD137C0C2E9BEC8A148C77AC76208BF69D0B0F3D5FBF665BF816A125`
- versionCode: `70004`
- APK signature: v1 / v2 / v3 verified
- No phone or emulator was connected in this environment, so no automated
  on-device regression test was run.
